title: 영역 믹스 솔로 #109 · 블루블랙·검정 배경 고정 명화 믹스 · 대각 띠·매끈 · 5영역(무하+클림트+반 고흐+칸딘스키+뭉크) · super hourglass · 오른 힙 팝 · 블루블랙 · 배경 검정 스튜디오 · 메이크업 없음(블루블랙)
prompt:
Professional fashion photograph, full body shot. ONE woman standing.

THE ABSOLUTE DARKEST BLACK SKIN ON EARTH blue-black void complexion darker than night sky, early 20s goddess, super hourglass physique THE MOST EXTREME PHYSICALLY POSSIBLE beyond all anatomy limits — waist cinched to absolute impossible minimum, hips AND bust simultaneously flaring to absolute maximum beyond any proportion, most dramatic hourglass ratio ever recorded on any human body, thighs so thick pressing together, silver-white natural hair swept into a high sculpted crown — her body is painted in 5 different painting styles at once, each style claiming its own region of her figure. Her figure is divided into 5 diagonal bands by 4 parallel hazy transition zones running from the upper left to the lower right as seen by the camera, crossing the centre line of her figure about 33% of the way down her figure from the top, about 47% of the way down her figure from the top, about 59% of the way down her figure from the top and about 80% of the way down her figure from the top. Region 1 is everything on the upper side of the first diagonal transition zone: it carries Mucha style Art Nouveau flowing floral curves with soft pastel flowers and ornamental whiplash lines. Region 2 is the diagonal band between transition zone 1 and transition zone 2: it carries Klimt style golden spirals and mosaic squares with ornate gold, black and green geometric ornaments. Region 3 is the diagonal band between transition zone 2 and transition zone 3: it carries Van Gogh Starry Night style swirling thick brushstrokes in deep ultramarine, cobalt and glowing yellow, big spiralling skies flowing over her curves. Region 4 is the diagonal band between transition zone 3 and transition zone 4: it carries Kandinsky style abstract composition of bold circles, triangles and sweeping lines in saturated red, blue, yellow and black. Region 5 is everything on the lower side of the last diagonal transition zone: it carries Munch The Scream style flowing wavy bands of blood-orange, blue and black swirling over her curves. Where two regions meet, the two neighbouring paintings blend along the edge: brushwork of one reaches into the other and the two styles simply touch, so the boundary is made only of the two neighbouring paintings, with no gap between them. Each transition zone follows a smooth, even, straight course, every painting laid on her own living skin and covering her completely from neck to ankle. Her face and ears stay real living blue-black skin with visible pores, fine peach-fuzz hairs and a soft natural flush. Pose: strong hip pop right, both hands pressing sides of hips outward simultaneously arching back to extreme, every region clearly visible to the camera — most extreme super hourglass silhouette ever displayed.
extreme platform stiletto heels of real glossy patent leather, each in a main colour of whichever painting that leg falls in, and extra long nails each polished in a main colour of whichever painting that hand falls in.

MANDATORY pure pitch black void background only, absolutely NO studio backdrop NO texture NO grey NO gradient. ONE woman only. Extreme macro detail on every brush stroke and every blended transition. Pattern density MAXIMUM — every inch from neck to ankle filled with painting. 8K portrait 2:3 aspect ratio.
